mapper.select: SELECT spu.id AS spuId -- 浏览量：一个用户可以有多次 , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product_browse_history WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS browse_count -- 访客量：按用户去重计数 , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM product_browse_history WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS browse_user_count -- 收藏数量：按用户去重计数 , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM product_favorite WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS favorite_count -- 加购数量：按用户去重计数 , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM trade_cart WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS cart_count -- 下单件数 , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(count), 0) FROM trade_order_item WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS order_count -- 支付件数 , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(item.count), 0) FROM trade_order_item item JOIN trade_order o ON item.order_id = o.id WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND o.pay_status = TRUE AND item.create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS order_pay_count -- 支付金额 , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(item.pay_price), 0) FROM trade_order_item item JOIN trade_order o ON item.order_id = o.id WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND o.pay_status = TRUE AND item.create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS order_pay_price -- 退款件数 , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(count), 0) FROM trade_after_sale WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND refund_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS after_sale_count -- 退款金额 , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(refund_price), 0) FROM trade_after_sale WHERE spu_id = spu.id AND refund_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) AS after_sale_refund_price FROM product_spu spu WHERE spu.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY spu.id
mapper.sql: SUM(ps.browse_count) AS browse_count, SUM(ps.browse_user_count) AS browse_user_count, SUM(ps.favorite_count) AS favorite_count, SUM(ps.cart_count) AS cart_count, SUM(ps.order_count) AS order_count, SUM(ps.order_pay_count) AS order_pay_count, SUM(ps.order_pay_price) AS order_pay_price, SUM(ps.after_sale_count) AS after_sale_count, SUM(ps.after_sale_refund_price) AS after_sale_refund_price, SUM(ps.known_cost_amount) AS known_cost_amount, SUM(ps.exact_cost_item_count) AS exact_cost_item_count, SUM(ps.estimated_cost_item_count) AS estimated_cost_item_count, SUM(ps.missing_cost_item_count) AS missing_cost_item_count, MAX(ps.profit_data_quality) AS profit_data_quality, MAX(ps.traffic_data_status) AS traffic_data_status, MIN(ps.traffic_watermark) AS traffic_watermark, MIN(ps.trade_watermark) AS trade_watermark, MIN(ps.refund_watermark) AS refund_watermark

SELECT ps.spu_id AS spu_id,
GROUP BY ps.spu_id

choose.when: AND aggregated.traffic_data_status = 1 AND aggregated.browse_count >= 100 AND (aggregated.order_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(aggregated.browse_count, 0)) < 1.0
AND aggregated.order_pay_count >= 10 AND aggregated.order_pay_price >= 100000 AND (aggregated.after_sale_refund_price * 100.0 / NULLIF(aggregated.order_pay_price, 0)) > 10.0

AND #{includeProfit} = TRUE AND aggregated.profit_data_quality != 4 AND aggregated.missing_cost_item_count = 0 AND ( (aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price - aggregated.known_cost_amount) < 0 OR ( aggregated.order_pay_count >= 5 AND (aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price) > 0 AND ((aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price - aggregated.known_cost_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price, 0)) < 10.0 ) )

mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
aggregated.spu_id
(CASE WHEN aggregated.traffic_data_status = 1 THEN aggregated.browse_count END) IS NULL, (CASE WHEN aggregated.traffic_data_status = 1 THEN aggregated.browse_count END)
aggregated.order_count
aggregated.after_sale_refund_price
(CASE WHEN aggregated.traffic_data_status = 1 THEN aggregated.order_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(aggregated.browse_count, 0) END) IS NULL, (CASE WHEN aggregated.traffic_data_status = 1 THEN aggregated.order_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(aggregated.browse_count, 0) END)
(CASE WHEN #{includeProfit} != TRUE OR aggregated.missing_cost_item_count > 0 THEN NULL ELSE aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price - aggregated.known_cost_amount END) IS NULL, (CASE WHEN #{includeProfit} != TRUE OR aggregated.missing_cost_item_count > 0 THEN NULL ELSE aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price - aggregated.known_cost_amount END)
(CASE WHEN #{includeProfit} != TRUE OR aggregated.missing_cost_item_count > 0 OR aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE (aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price - aggregated.known_cost_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price, 0) END) IS NULL, (CASE WHEN #{includeProfit} != TRUE OR aggregated.missing_cost_item_count > 0 OR aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE (aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price - aggregated.known_cost_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(aggregated.order_pay_price - aggregated.after_sale_refund_price, 0) END)
aggregated.order_pay_price
ASC DESC , aggregated.spu_id ASC
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN ps.traffic_data_status != 3 THEN ps.time END) AS time,

SELECT ps.time AS time,
GROUP BY ps.time ORDER BY ps.time ASC
